title: Immunocore presents updated Phase 1 data of brenetafusp in patients with heavily pretreated advanced melanoma
author: Immunocore Holdings Plc
description: Immunocore announced updated Phase 1/2 trial results for brenetafusp in heavily pretreated advanced melanoma patients, showing a 6-month overall survival rate of 87% and disease control rate of 52%. The 160 mcg dose was selected for the ongoing Phase 3 PRISM-MEL-301 trial. The drug demonstrated clinical benefit in difficult-to-treat subgroups including patients with primary PD-1 resistance and was generally well tolerated as monotherapy and in combination with pembrolizumab.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company reported promising clinical trial results for brenetafusp with strong efficacy metrics (87% 6-month OS rate, 52% DCR) in heavily pretreated patients, including those with PD-1 resistance. The selection of the 160 mcg dose for Phase 3 trials and favorable safety profile support continued development momentum and potential market opportunity.

title: Immunocore reports first quarter financial results and provides a business update
author: Immunocore Holdings Plc
description: Immunocore reported Q1 2026 net sales of $106.7 million for KIMMTRAK, representing 14% year-over-year growth. The company presented landmark five-year overall survival data at AACR showing KIMMTRAK doubled the likelihood of being alive at five years (16% vs 8%) for HLA-A*02:01 positive metastatic uveal melanoma patients. The company maintains $845 million in cash and is advancing its pipeline including Phase 3 trials for cutaneous melanoma expansion and PRAME-targeted candidates.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong commercial performance with 14% YoY sales growth for lead product KIMMTRAK, landmark five-year survival data showing doubled OS benefit, solid cash position of $845 million, and expanding pipeline with multiple Phase 3 trials progressing. Net income improved to $13.0 million from $5.0 million YoY. Company is executing on multiple growth opportunities including market expansion and new indications.

title: KIMMTRAK doubles the likelihood of being alive at five years for first line HLA-A*02:01+ patients with metastatic uveal melanoma
author: Immunocore Holdings Plc
description: Immunocore announced five-year overall survival data for KIMMTRAK (tebentafusp-tebn) in metastatic uveal melanoma, showing 16% OS versus 8% in control arm. The drug doubled survival likelihood and demonstrated durability across poor prognostic subgroups, representing the longest follow-up for any T cell engager in solid tumors.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong clinical data showing KIMMTRAK doubled five-year survival rates (16% vs 8%) in metastatic uveal melanoma with durable benefit across poor prognostic subgroups. This represents the longest follow-up for any T cell engager in solid tumors and solidifies the drug as first-line standard of care, supporting commercial potential and lifecycle management opportunities.

title: Immunocore to present at upcoming investor conferences
author: Na
